dedupe_keys.name: dados hidrologicos volume de espera recomendado

description: ONS publishes recommended maximum useful-storage percentages for reservoir hydraulic scheduling. The limits retain space to attenuate floods and reduce downstream inundation, using maximum-flow restrictions and recurrence assumptions supplied by generating agents. Reservoir identifiers, cascade order, date and recommended percentage are documented. These operating constraints support reservoir and flood-management modelling. They do not describe observed storage volumes. File labels include a 2027 edition; this is not evidence of future observations. Coverage is individual reservoirs in Brazil. The catalogue lists CSV, Excel and Parquet files; files are free under the provider's CC-BY terms, with no version specified. ONS requires attribution and disclosure of changes. Data contents were not downloaded; completeness is unknown, and published values may be revised. Related ONS generation-by-plant data provide a comparison series.
